approval_evidence.quote: AUVELITY (dextromethorphan hydrobromide and bupropion hydrochloride) extended-release tablets, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 2022

notes: Scope is Auvelity U.S. net sales as the issuer prints them. Sunosi is a separate line and is excluded. Q1 and Q2 2023 are printed in the own 10-Qs only as rounded text ($15.7 million and $27.6 million); the exact figures are the prior-year columns of the 2024 Q1 and Q2 10-Qs, so those derivations are direct_prior_year_column. Q4 2022 equals the full year 2022 because there were no sales before the October 2022 launch; the full year 2022 figure is the prior-year column of the FY2023 10-K. Q4 values for later years are derived from the annual figure less nine months.
